question: What is the size of the Mojeek Search API free credit, and does it expire?
why: No page read states either. The API page says 'claim a free credit' (and, in Wayback Machine captures up to 2026-10-01, 'Free trial version, with limited queries. Get in touch.'), a vendor forum reply of December 2025 says 'claim some credits', and the API terms and documentation give no amount or expiry. The figure appears only inside an account opened with an email address and a bank card, or in an answer from the vendor's API contact, api@mojeek.com, which a vendor forum reply names. A lane may not create an account or enter a card, so reading the credit and its expiry is an operator step.
